FORTISBC ENERGY INC.
For the Year Ended December 31, 2021
The Corporation is serving approximately 1,050,000 residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers.

Both 2021 and 2020 net earnings are based on an allowed ROE of 8.75 per cent and a deemed equity component of capital structure of 38.5 per cent.
The assumed discount rate, used to measure the projected pension benefit obligations on the measurement date of December 31, 2021, and to determine the pension net benefit cost for 2022, is 3.10 per cent.
